audience: Expeditionary/underway Sailors capturing documents offline on tablets; command staff and Training, Supply and Admin reviewer roles. All data is synthetic.
primaryTask: Extract both forms and a week of tasking, correct cited candidates, save and validate, review the exact revision, route locally offline, then reconcile conflicts and deliver through a labeled reconnect simulator.
successOutcome: Three named forms, five verified actions, draft status updates and a filing manifest survive reload; local inbox receipts are visible; reviewed simulated replicas converge without duplicate remote receipts.

screens.name: Packet workspace
screens.purpose: Read image/text sources beside extracted fields; correct uncertainty and inspect citations, validation and saved versus unsaved state.

screens.name: Review and local inboxes
screens.purpose: Review committed forms, actions, status and filing; deliberately approve the exact saved revision and route locally.
screens.primaryAction: Approve reviewed revision, then Route locally

screens.name: Reconnect and conflict review
screens.purpose: Inspect competing values including deleted task; choose each result and review again. Secondary sync lab demonstrates replay, order and byte-budget recovery.

screens.name: Evidence and path to fleet
screens.purpose: Export six named outputs, source/audit history and honest synthetic metrics; expose deferred judgments and operational gaps.

states.empty: Explain both tracks and offer Load synthetic packet. No automatic sample load or silent reset. Stable controls remain labeled; no PII entry is requested.
states.loading: During IndexedDB open, extraction, save and reconnect show an explicit local progress message and disable duplicate actions until completion. Saved appears only after transaction completion; all sources are inline and need no network.
states.error: Inline errors name invalid fields; route shows the specific validation, dirty-draft or missing-review block. Save failure retains editable draft; missing history preserves queue. Conflicts show both values with explicit choices. Simulated faults are labeled secondary tools.
states.success: Show Saved locally, 0 errors, reviewed current revision, local inbox receipts and remote queued separately. Reconnect success explicitly says simulated; named outputs remain readable and exportable.

persistence: IndexedDB transactionally stores sources, drafts, packet revisions, reviewer decisions, audit, two local replicas, inbox receipts and receiver-acknowledged offsets. Reopen index.html at the same file/origin to recover offline. Show storage-unavailable failure with recovery export; never fall back silently to volatile saved state. No encryption claim. Keep unsaved draft distinct from committed content; export committed and recovery data separately.
recovery: Correct invalid fields without losing other work. Require Save or Discard unsaved changes before approving/routing; saving or resolving conflicts invalidates prior approval. Conflict review shows subject variants and edit-versus-delete and requires deliberate selection/custom value for each. Retain queue on missing history. Retry saves and interrupted acknowledgements. Ordinary navigation/reload preserves work; do not expose destructive reset without confirmation and recovery export.
keyboard: Use native labeled inputs, selects, buttons and checkbox; logical Tab order source → candidates → save → validation → review → route; visible focus; Enter/Space activates buttons. Announce save/error/conflict status in live regions, associate field errors with inputs and focus the first error after validation. Narrow layout stacks source/review panes without hiding outputs or horizontal page scrolling.
